name: China Bester Group Telecom Co., Ltd.
summary: China Bester Group Telecom Co., Ltd. engages in the provision of communication network technology services in China. It offers network construction services, including 5G mobile communication networks; gigabit optical transmission networks; and other digital infrastructures, such as network planning and design, project implementation and delivery, system network maintenance, and integrated services. The company also provides computing power, storage, cloud services, and solutions based on cloud servers to governments and industries; and services related to smart city projects. China Bester Group Telecom Co., Ltd. was founded in 1992 and is based in Wuhan, China.
